rationale: All trace points remain connected and above the ride-through envelope. Voltage at t=0.05s (0.55 pu) triggers the reactive current requirement; by t=0.12s (before the 0.1s deadline from sag onset at t=0.05s), iq_pu reaches 0.25, exceeding the 0.2 minimum. After the deadline, voltage recovers to 0.9 pu or above, so no further reactive support is required.
